clue.text: TV series of course had to be edited before screening starts

indicators.note: the scrambled letters come before the initial taken from screening
editing reworks text, so the letters of the three words before it are rearranged
starts asks for the opening letter of the word screening

explanation.surface: A television show had to be cut and polished before it could be broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be edited' rearranges OF COURSE HAD into HOUSEOFCARD, and 'starts' adds the S of screening. The answer runs across 1 and 19 across.
explanation.definitionFit: A political drama shown first on the BBC and later remade by Netflix carries this title.

clue.text: Charity worker dismissed

parts.note: a hand is a manual labourer, as in farmhand
a batter who is dismissed in cricket is out

explanation.surface: A charity employee has been sacked.
explanation.definitionFit: Charity in the sense of a free gift to the needy is a dole or alms given out.

clue.text: Relative heartless warders stripped more in the dark than before

definitions.text: more in the dark than before

parts.note: an uncle is a family relative

indicators.note: heartless removes the central letter of what remains after stripping
stripped takes off the outer letters of warders, leaving its inside

explanation.surface: A relative finds the prison guards have been stripped, which leaves things murkier than ever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stripped' turns WARDERS into ARDER; 'heartless' then removes its middle D, leaving ARER.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone less clear about something than before is more confused, more in the dark.

clue.text: Takes home containers, so they say

indicators.note: so they say signals that the word for containers is spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: urns are vessels for holding liquid or ashes

explanation.surface: Someone carries storage pots home, or so the rumour goes.
explanation.definitionFit: Take-home pay is what a worker is paid, so to take home a sum is to be paid it.

clue.text: Signal a physical before splitting company

indicators.note: splitting says the pair of pieces break the word for company apart

parts.note: a firm is a business company

indicators.note: physical comes before a in the order of the letters

parts.note: physical things are real, tangible

explanation.surface: A company is split by the signal that one of its staff needs a physical examination.
explanation.definitionFit: A bell or siren warning occupants of a blaze is a signal to evacuate.

clue.text: Follower of 1 across sometimes turns gold

parts.note: a road that winds turns this way and that
or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: Something that follows a track sometimes turns golden.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 across begins HOUSE OF, and the royal House of Windsor is one thing that follows it.
explanation.definitionFit: The British royal family's dynastic name follows 'House of', as do other words.

clue.text: Graves possibly heard to complain

indicators.note: heard says the word for the drink is spoken and another word is written

parts.note: Graves is a Bordeaux region whose red and white is an example of the drink

explanation.surface: Robert Graves, perhaps, was overheard grumbling.
explanation.walkthrough: Graves looks like the poet or a cemetery; here it is the Bordeaux district and its produce.
explanation.definitionFit: To moan or grumble in a nasal, plaintive tone is to complain.

clue.text: Organ's in smash Prince hit

indicators.note: a smash breaks something to pieces, so the letters of the next two words are reassembled

explanation.surface: A rock star called Prince had a smash hit in the charts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smash hit' reads as one phrase, but 'smash' is the anagram signal on PRINCE HIT.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes things relating to the kidney, a bodily organ, so it stands for 'of the organ'.

clue.text: Controversy as special soldiers invade Turkmenistan

indicators.note: invade puts the soldiers inside the country's code

parts.note: TM is the international code for Turkmenistan
OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Elite troops invading a Central Asian republic would cause an international row.
explanation.definitionFit: A storm of protest is an outburst of controversy, a public uproar.

clue.text: Reason for game being delayed causes blow-up again

definitions.meaning: read as two words, a referee arriving late would hold up the kick-off
to inflate a tyre or an economy once more

explanation.surface: A late kick-off explains why something was inflated a second time.
explanation.walkthrough: The first reading splits the answer into REF LATE, an official arriving late.
explanation.definitionFit: To pump up the money supply again, or put air back into something, is to inflate it again.

clue.text: It's subtler to freeze resistance on the end of 19

indicators.note: on places the frozen piece and resistance after the closing letter

parts.note: nineteen spelt out finishes with the letter N
to ice something is to freeze or chill it
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A card player claims it is cleverer to keep resistance cold at the end of the game.
explanation.walkthrough: 19 elsewhere means the cards, but here the number itself, written out as a word, supplies its final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A nice distinction is a fine or delicate one, so nicer means finer, more subtle.

clue.text: Music including popular cover won't get wet

indicators.note: including puts the word for popular inside the music

parts.note: rap is a style of music
in means fashionable, popular
a roof covers a building

explanation.surface: A band's popular tune under a cover will stay dry.
explanation.definitionFit: Something impervious to showers keeps its contents dry in bad weather.

clue.text: Clear area removes top step

parts.note: taking the lid or top off a jar opens it
a pace is a single step

explanation.surface: Clearing a space means taking away the top step.
explanation.definitionFit: A stretch of land left free of buildings is open, unobstructed ground.

clue.text: Strange bedfellows begin with a dance

parts.note: rum is old British slang for odd, strange

indicators.note: begin picks out the opening letter of bedfellows

explanation.surface: Unlikely partners start off together with a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A Cuban ballroom style with a syncopated rhythm is a dance.

clue.text: 19 pitch books

parts.note: tar is black pitch
OT is the Old Testament, a set of books

explanation.surface: A pitch made for some books.
explanation.walkthrough: 19 across is CARDS, and the definition is a kind of them.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarot pack is a deck of cards used in fortune-telling and some games.

clue.text: Randomly determine actions — so explosive!

indicators.note: explosive suggests blowing apart, so the letters of the two words before it are scattered

explanation.surface: Deciding what to do at random — how volatile!
explanation.definitionFit: Flipping a penny to see heads or tails settles a choice by chance.

clue.text: Excellent spot to hold meet — the French will be flexible

parts.note: A, as in a grade A, means first-rate

indicators.note: to hold puts the word for fitting inside the word for spot

parts.note: a dab is a small spot or blob
meet in the old sense means fitting, apt
le is the French masculine definite article

explanation.surface: A first-rate venue for a gathering, with a French touch, can adapt to anything.
explanation.walkthrough: 'meet' is not a gathering but the old adjective meaning suitable.
explanation.definitionFit: Able to change to suit circumstances, so pliant and versatile.

clue.text: Article about mad cow disease supports people away

indicators.note: about puts the article around the disease

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
BSE, bovine spongiform encephalopathy, is mad cow disease
golf tees support the ball

explanation.surface: A newspaper article on mad cow disease props up people who are away.
explanation.definitionFit: Those not present, missing from work or a meeting, are the ones away.

clue.text: Crash car banned in country event

indicators.note: a crash wrecks a car, so the letters of the two words after it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A car is banned after a crash at a rural event.
explanation.definitionFit: A rustic social with folk dancing, traditionally held in a farm building, is a country event.

clue.text: Companion backing Montana teacher as sort of 19

parts.note: CH is Companion of Honour, a British order

indicators.note: backing reverses the state and the teacher together

parts.note: MT is the postal abbreviation for Montana
sir is how British pupils address a male teacher

explanation.surface: A companion is supporting a teacher from Montana as some sort of card.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns MT SIR into RISTM. 19 across is CARDS.
explanation.definitionFit: Cards sent at the festive season in December are one particular kind.

clue.text: Green benches are seen here after 1 across parks

definitions.text: Green benches are seen here after 1 across
definitions.meaning: the lower chamber of Parliament, House of ..., has green leather benches
public greens or open land shared by a town

explanation.surface: Green benches stand in the parks after a house.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 across begins HOUSE OF; the elected chamber of the UK Parliament follows it.
explanation.definitionFit: Shared grassland in a town, like Clapham's, is public parkland.

clue.text: See 1
Hat to be kept by child

parts.note: stet is the proofreader's mark meaning let it stand, keep it
a son is a child

explanation.surface: A hat is to be held on to by a youngster.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall, wide-brimmed cowboy hat is named after its American maker.

clue.text: German scholars confine molten rock

indicators.note: confine keeps the German letter shut inside the scholars

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts, so two scholars give two of them

explanation.surface: German academics lock up some molten rock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scholars' is plural, so it gives two lots of MA, with the G between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid rock beneath the earth's crust is what erupts as lava.

clue.text: Partly reviving a torpid swimmer

indicators.note: Partly says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone is partly bringing a sluggish swimmer back to life.
explanation.definitionFit: The short form of alligator names a reptile that swims in rivers and swamps.

clue.text: Jingle due for revision by court official

indicators.note: revision means reworking, so the letters of the two words before it are reordered

explanation.surface: A jingle is due to be revised by a court official.
explanation.definitionFit: At tennis, the person who calls whether the ball landed in or out is an official on court.

clue.text: 1 across sometimes seen next to this ground

definitions.text: 1 across sometimes seen next to this
definitions.meaning: the upper chamber of Parliament follows House of ...
the London cricket ground in St John's Wood, home of the MCC

explanation.surface: A house is sometimes seen beside this ground.
explanation.walkthrough: Lord's is London's most famous cricket ground; the House of Lords is Parliament's upper chamber.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous London cricket venue bears the name of its founder Thomas Lord.

clue.text: John Kerry loses footing twice getting to one of 19

indicators.note: each of the two names loses its last two letters, its feet, from the bottom of the word

explanation.surface: The US politician John Kerry stumbles twice on his way to a card game.
explanation.walkthrough: JOHN drops HN and KERRY drops RY, leaving JO and KER.
explanation.definitionFit: A wild card with a jester's picture is one card in the pack.

clue.text: Delegate well after being comatose

indicators.note: after being puts the well's word after the word for comatose

parts.note: someone out cold is comatose
a well is a source of water

explanation.surface: A patient's well again after being in a coma.
explanation.definitionFit: To hand a task to an outside contractor is to delegate it.

clue.text: 19 volunteers leave receipts

indicators.note: leave says the volunteers depart from the receipts

parts.note: takings are a shop's receipts
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: Volunteers walk off leaving the receipts behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 19 across is CARDS; the answer is a set of them.
explanation.definitionFit: A deck holds four court cards of the highest rank below the ace.

clue.text: Quiet king signs contracts

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
R is for rex, Latin for king
to ink a deal is to sign it

explanation.surface: A quiet monarch puts his name to agreements.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contracts' looks like a noun for the deals; it is the verb meaning gets smaller.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that contracts gets smaller, as wool does in a hot wash.

clue.text: Grouse about northern doctor

indicators.note: about signals that the letters of grouse are moved around

explanation.surface: Someone moans about a doctor from the north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grouse' looks like a verb or a bird; 'about' rearranges its letters to SURGEO.
explanation.definitionFit: A medical practitioner who operates is a kind of doctor.
